kind: production deploy of coordinator-built (shipped) txid display recent runtimes to the tiered proof of concept, with live measurement until the proof of concept was replaced by txid display v2
deployment: production: recent-01 worker binary (drop-in zz-latency.conf, binary path only) and the coordinator controller (drop-in zz-ship.conf: --ship-runtimes, TRANSPARENT_BUILD_THREADS=2), under /run/lock/wallet-pir-production.lock 10:45:04-10:55:08Z; both drop-ins removed at 13:21Z by the v2 cutover session

source.deploy_head: 28c39d94 on branch claude/shipped-runtimes-lint-d993bc75 = main 98792569 (reviewed change 6b8c5c91..d993bc75) + clippy fixes + restore slot released after the shipped read

build: roman-dev-2, cargo build --locked --release -p transparent-shard-server --bin transparent-txid-server -p transparent-filter-server --bin txid-display-controller; RUSTFLAGS=-C target-cpu=x86-64-v3 -C target-feature=+pclmulqdq; toolchain 1.97.1; hashes in raw/deploy/binaries-28c39d94.sha256
command: harness/deploy-recent.sh 28c39d94; harness/deploy-controller.sh 28c39d94; harness/watch-cycles.sh 5; harness/supervise.py OUT harness/sshp.sh (sshp.sh not retained, hosts by alias); harness/drive.sh START B-20lps-lookup-shipped lookup 20 4 600 --cold-every 25; harness/analyze.py OUT B-20lps-lookup-shipped 600; harness/prepare_pairing.py OUT B-20lps-lookup-shipped; harness/window300.py OUT raw/controller/timeline-tail.jsonl 2233 121

hosts.coordinator: DO dedicated, Xeon Gold 6548N, 8 vCPU, controller unit CPUQuota=200% CPUWeight=20 Nice=10 MemoryMax=4G, Ubuntu glibc 2.39; shared from ~11:56Z with another session's genesis v2 bootstrap (ionice idle, io pressure some 23-26%)
hosts.recent-01: DO-Regular 2.0 GHz, 4 vCPU, 8 GiB; worker CPUQuota=200% CPUWeight=50 Nice=10 TRANSPARENT_BUILD_THREADS=2 MemoryMax=1.5G; shares the host with the transparent history shard server
hosts.bench: roman-ipir-bench-8vcpu (8 vCPU) running txid-rate against https://transparent-pir.valargroup.dev
hosts.mac: read-only supervisor and deploy scripts over SSH through the coordinator jump host

workload.B1: txid-rate lookup, 20/s total over 4 processes, 600 s, fixture-natural-p0..3 (4,000 samples: recent 1,955 inline + 45 pages-1, archive 1,921 inline + 79 pages-1, 200 absent), mix recent=0.8 archive=0.2, --cold-every 25
workload.background: transparent 5 QPS history load (coordinator) throughout; no other display load

ship_p50_p95_s: stop rule 2 s; before 0.47/2.37 at 16 MiB

limits: 121 cycles, not 300: the proof of concept was stopped at 13:21Z for the v2 cutover
one interference window (B1); the second was refused after supervisor trips on pre-existing history spikes and the stop
ship times from 11:56Z overlap another session's I/O-heavy bootstrap on the coordinator; the copy tail was already over 2 s before it
worker CPU from 30 s unit counters over quiet segments, not per-prepare sampling
history collateral compared against one previous day
